I've always wanted to be into JRPGs, but I've just never been able to. I bought Etrian Odyssey IV and played the Bravely Default demo, but ended up bored pretty quickly. I also tried Tales of Vesperia, but it got so rote that I never finished it. I'd pretty much given up on being into JRPGs (with the exception of Pokemon) until my friend got me to play Persona 4. I like pretty much every aspect of that game, from the combat to the Persona-collecting to the social links and life sim aspects.

Obviously, I've played P4 on my friend's Vita, but I, myself, have a 3DS. If anyone can recommend me any JRPGs that might pique my interests, I'd really appreciate it. Thanks!
Could anyone recommend me JRPGs like Persona 4 or Pokemon for the 3DS?

Have you tried the Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Survivor series? I've only played the first one, but it was a lot of fun. The style is very much like Persona and you collect demons pretty much the same as Pokemon, but you get to evolve and mix them as well. The story is really good to! Definitely more adult themed, definitely worth a shot if you like Persona and Pokemon, it's kind of a mix of the two.
Fire Emblem: Awakening is a really good JRPG I enjoyed.

Agreed with the Devil Survivor recommendation.

SMT: Devil Summoner: Soul Hackers (Don't confuse it with Devil Survivor) might also be worth a play. Some of the systems are a bit dated since its a Sega Saturn port, but the game itself is solid. The one thing you'll have to learn is the negotiation system to get Demons to join you; Survivor and Persona 3/4 abandoned this. SMT IV is worth playing as well. Its the most modern of the SMT games, and probably the closest non-Persona game to P4. I've heard good things about Strange Journey for the DS too, but haven't played it myself yet.

P4 (well the SMT series in general too) is pretty unique, it's hard to recommend anything else based on it. The only things I can think of is make sure you've played Pokemon Black/White and Black/White 2, because they're the best games for single player.

If you're willing to emulate (and its dirt easy emulating PSP and SNES) I'd recommend Earthbound and Persona 3: Portable. Both are well worth playing, having their own unique charms. Persona 1/2 if you can emulate PS1 or PSP are good too, but quite a bit different than 3/4.
I second Shin Megami Tensei IV. This game is phenomenal.
